qualifiers.online / jogar online: ONLY for the 29 interactive app types; worksheet-gen families (counting-pictures, counting-frames, tally-counting, number-charts, comparing-*, number-lines, base-ten, telling-time, fractions, graphing-data, arrays-multiplication, geometry, measurement, visual-*, patterns, position-words, sorting-categories, picture-arithmetic, science-*, beginning-sounds, letter-knowledge, word-building, picture-vocabulary, phonological-awareness) are printable-only
